**Privacy update: installing it is recommended.**

- Wardriving: when a capture started, the exclusion list was not applied during roughly the first second, so excluded networks and devices (your own, for example) heard in that moment could be recorded in the database and sent to WiGLE. The list is now read before the first scan, new exclusions apply at once during a capture, and every network is checked again just before it is written
- Excluded networks that were recorded this way are removed from the database automatically when the next capture starts. Those already sent to WiGLE cannot be removed from the app: they have to be removed on WiGLE.net
